basic_info.description: ||| Open House, Wednesday 10/30, 3:30-5:00PM |||    441 Green Street is a VACANT duplex located in the Telegraph Hill District of San Francisco.        The property features two full-floor flats (2BR/1BA and 2BR/2BA). Notable amenities include a terraced backyard, 2 car garage, and laundry. The property is separately metered for gas and electric and units enjoy views of Coit Tower. Entire property shall be delivered vacant at close of escrow.  This asset presents an excellent add-value opportunity for potential buyers.     Situated in Telegraph Hill, the property is walking distance to an abundance of neighborhood amenities and the Financial District. Telegraph Hill is known for its sunny weather, top-notch dining, bars, and Washington Square Park. Walker's Paradise, 10 minute walk from Downtown/Financial District.    The investment appeal of this property is its add-value/ upside potential, vacant units, and its excellent location.
